frozen_trunk.note: trunk is never updated; every head sees the frozen 80-d representation h(X) plus, for the state family only, point-in-time stock state s(d-1)

hypotheses.R15: The same book shape means different things under high/low volatility, wide/narrow spread and active/quiet conditions. A gate that reads only point-in-time stock state (never the current bar's own features) should let one frozen representation specialise per stock state.
hypotheses.R16: Mean reversion ignores tails and skew. Predicting three fixed quantiles (0.2/0.5/0.8) of the same 30-minute label with a pinball loss exposes asymmetric tails that a single MSE head cannot express.

minimal_experiment.shared: All heads are small probes on the frozen trunk representation extracted once per row from the seed-11 @1.32 trunk; training rows are exactly the trunk training window (2022-01-04..2023-11-01) selected by the same recipe.
minimal_experiment.R15: statistics-bypass head (state only) -> concat-mlp control (rep + state) -> gate head (state gates rep channels); the bypass head decides whether gating complexity is worth it. Parameter counts are matched between the gate head and its concat control (reported, tolerance 1.2%).
minimal_experiment.R16: rep-mlp control with two outputs collapses to a single MSE head; the treatment is an 80->64->3 pinball head with a parameter-matched rep-mlp control trained with the same schedule.

arms.rep_mlp: 80-d representation -> 64 -> scalar (MSE; control for R15 concat and R16)
arms.stats_linear: 4-d point-in-time state -> scalar (R15 statistics bypass, no representation)
arms.r15_gate: 80-d representation -> 64 channels gated by sigma(W_s s) -> scalar (R15 treatment)
arms.s_base: frozen trunk raw score, no head (reference)

score_rules.r16_quantile: the traded score is the predicted median q50 only; q20/q80 are reported as tail diagnostics and MUST NOT be combined into an expected return
score_rules.r15_gate: the traded score is the gated scalar output; gate inputs are restricted to 4 point-in-time state variables
score_rules.others: the traded score is the single scalar head output
score_rules.point_in_time: every state variable uses days strictly earlier than the prediction day (shift(1) then a 20-day rolling window)

windows.note: the two confirmation blocks are never read by this route; only the captain may judge them once

decision_criteria.primary: paired per-trading-day delta of rank IC against the existing 3-seed blend basis (s_base = frozen trunk score) and against each arm's parameter-matched control, with a 5-day moving-block bootstrap interval (20000 draws, seed 20261028) over the pooled 8 screening windows
decision_criteria.secondary: long-short return, turnover (U/2), tail behaviour and inference cost are reported next to every delta; a positive rank-IC delta with a materially worse long-short or turnover is not a pass
decision_criteria.verdict: R15 and R16 each pass only if the pooled paired delta interval excludes zero in favour of the treatment; otherwise the route is reported as a negative result with its mechanism
decision_criteria.no_post_hoc_thresholds: criteria fixed before scoring; no threshold may be revised after seeing results

cost_budget.compute: one frozen-trunk extraction pass (about 5M rows) plus six small heads trained for 3000 steps on a single GPU
cost_budget.inference: each head is a 2-layer MLP on an 80-d vector, except the gate head which adds a 4-d gate
